name: Hazama Ando Corporation
summary: Hazama Ando Corporation engages in construction and related business in Japan and internationally. The company offers civil engineering, building, and other construction services. Its projects include offices, production and distribution facilities, medical and welfare facilities, educational and research facilities, airports, dams, water/sewer systems, tunnels, roads and land reclamation, disaster prevention, bridges, and other public works and buildings.
